functions.name: WillProvideMipDataWithoutDisk
functions.docs:
Returns true if TextureMipDataProviders allocated by this factory can provide MipData by themselves,
even without loading from disk at all, so streaming can be enabled for their textures.

functions.name: ShouldAllowPlatformTiling
functions.docs: Return whether the mip data provided by this provider is in "offline processed" format (i.e. pre-tiled specifically for the target platform)
